_comment: Row 263. Re-run from a detached standalone scratch tree: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row263_register_close_restamp.json --work SCRATCH. The mutant removes the authoritative restamp for a row already carrying a worker-supplied CLOSED tag. The named catcher builds a one-row register, runs the real close command with a different serialized-cut version, and requires the old tag to disappear. The separate transform-control spec applies the identical valid transform under a help-only test and must ESCAPE.
subject: an integrator close always restamps an already CLOSED worker row with the actual release version

mutants.label: M1 an existing CLOSED tag is trusted instead of being restamped by the integrator
